read.en: ❶ Meanwhile, many critics of AI raise concerns about its impact on employment.
read.ko: 한편, AI를 비판하는 많은 이들은 그것이 고용에 미치는 영향에 대한 우려를 제기한다.

read.en: ❷ Automation, they argue, will lead to widespread job losses, as machines and robots replace human workers in many industries.
read.ko: 자동화는, 그들의 주장에 따르면, 기계와 로봇이 많은 산업 분야에서 인간 노동자들을 대체함에 따라, 광범위한 실업을 초래할 것이다.

read.en: ❸ This could lead to increased poverty and income gap, as those who lose their jobs struggle to find new employment in an already competitive job market.
read.ko: 이는 실직한 이들이 이미 경쟁이 치열한 취업 시장에서 새로운 일자리를 찾느라 어려움을 겪음에 따라 빈곤과 소득 격차의 증가로 이어질 수 있다.

read.en: ❹ This argument is not without merit.
read.ko: 이 주장에는 타당한 점이 없지 않다.

read.en: ❺ Automation has already displaced workers in several industries, and it is likely that this trend will continue as AI becomes more widespread.
read.ko: 자동화는 이미 여러 산업에서 노동자들을 대체했고, AI가 더 확산되면서 이 경향이 계속될 가능성이 크다.

read.en: ❻ However, it is also important to consider that automation has been a driving force behind economic growth for centuries and has consistently created new job opportunities, even as it has decreased existing ones.
read.ko: 그러나, 자동화는 수백 년간 경제 성장 이면의 원동력이었고, 기존의 취업 기회를 감소시키는 한편 지속적으로 새로운 취업 기회를 창출해 왔다는 점을 고려하는 것 또한 중요하다.

read.en: ❼ For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service.
read.ko: 예를 들자면, 20세기 초 자동차 산업의 성장은 마부의 실직으로 이어졌지만, 제조, 판매, 서비스에서 새로운 직업을 창출하기도 했다.

read.en: ❶ For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service.
read.ko: 예를 들자면, 20세기 초 자동차 산업의 성장은 마부의 실직으로 이어졌지만, 제조, 판매, 서비스에서 새로운 직업을 창출하기도 했다.

read.en: ❷ The same can be said for the rise of the computer industry in the late 20th century, which displaced workers in manual labor industries, but also created new jobs in software development, information technology, and related fields.
read.ko: 수공업 노동자들을 물러나게 했지만, 소프트웨어 개발과 정보 기술을 비롯한 관련 분야에서 새 직업을 창출한 20세기 말 컴퓨터 산업의 부상도 마찬가지라 할 수 있다.

read.en: ❸ Therefore, it is likely that the rise of AI will also give rise to new job opportunities.
read.ko: 그러므로, AI의 부상 역시 새로운 일자리 기회를 생기게 할 것으로 보인다.

read.en: ❹ There will be a growing demand for data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI ethics experts, among others.
read.ko: 데이터 과학자, 기계 학습 공학자, AI 윤리 전문가 등에 대한 수요가 늘어날 것이다.

read.en: ❺ These jobs will allow individuals to contribute to society in meaningful ways.
read.ko: 이 직업들은 개인이 사회에 유의미하게 기여할 수 있게 해 줄 것이다.

read.en: ❻ At the same time, since they require new skills, education and training will need to evolve to help people prepare for these new opportunities.
read.ko: 동시에 이 직업들은 새로운 기술을 요구하기에, 사람들이 이 새로운 기회에 대비하는 데 도움이 되도록 교육과 훈련이 발전해야 할 것이다.

read.en: ❼ By adapting and learning, people can find paths in a world where AI plays a major role.
read.ko: 적응하고 학습함으로써, 사람들은 AI가 중요한 역할을 하는 세상에서 길을 찾을 수 있다.

read.en: ❶ Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to maintain existing biases and discrimination.
read.ko: 일부 비평가들은 기존의 편향과 차별을 지속시킬 가능성을 포함한 AI와 연관된 윤리적 문제에 우려를 표하기도 한다.

read.en: ❷ People often view computer systems as objective.
read.ko: 사람들은 종종 컴퓨터 시스템이 객관적이라고 여긴다.

read.en: ❸ However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely reproduce those biases in its output.
read.ko: 그러나 AI 시스템은 그것들이 훈련된 데이터가 편향되지 않은 만큼만 편향되지 않게 된다. 데이터에 편향이 있다면, AI 시스템은 산출물에 그 편향을 재현할 것 이다.

read.en: ❹ For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones.
read.ko: 예를 들어, 안면 인식 알고리즘은 특정 유형의 피부색을 가진 사람들을 인식할 때 정확성이 떨어진다는 것이 밝혀졌다.

read.en: ❺ This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones.
read.ko: 이는 피부색이 상대적으로 밝은 얼굴들 위주로 된 데이터 집합으로 그 알고리즘을 훈련했기 때문이다.

read.en: ❻ As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and wrongfully arrested by the police.
read.ko: 그 결과, 미국에서는 안면 인식 시스템에 의해 소수 인종에 속하는 사람들이 수배자로 잘못 식별되어 경찰에 부당하게 체포되는 사건들이 있었다.

read.en: ❼ This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.
read.ko: 이는 근거 있는 우려이고, 사회가 AI의 잠재적인 부정적 영향을 줄일 대책을 취하는 것이 중요하다.

read.en: ❶ In conclusion, the rise of AI is shaping the future of society in profound ways, and it is important that we consider both the potential benefits and challenges this technology presents.
read.ko: 결론적으로, AI의 부상은 사회의 미래를 심오하게 변화시키고 있으며, 이 기술이 보여 주는 잠재적 혜택과 문제를 모두 고려하는 것이 중요하다.

read.en: ❷ While AI has the potential to increase efficiency and productivity and solve complex problems, it also has the potential to cause job losses and continue existing biases.
read.ko: AI는 효율성과 생산성을 향상시키고 복잡한 문제를 해결할 가능성을 가지고 있지만, 실업을 야기하고 기존의 편향을 지속시킬 가능성 또한 가지고 있다.

read.en: ❸ However, as with any revolutionary technology, it is likely that the rise of AI will also create new job opportunities and contribute to economic growth.
read.ko: 그러나 모든 혁신 기술이 그러하듯, AI의 부상 또한 새로운 취업 기회를 만들고 경제 성장에 기여할 가능성이 크다.

read.en: ❹ It is the responsibility of society to ensure that the development and implementation of AI are done in a responsible and ethical manner.
read.ko: AI의 개발과 활용이 책임감 있고 윤리적인 방식으로 이루어지도록 하는 것은 사회의 책임이다.

read.en: ❺ This will require collaboration between governments, corporations, and individuals to establish regulations and standards, provide education and training programs, and ensure that the benefits of AI are shared equally.
read.ko: 이를 위해서는 규제와 기준을 확립하고, 교육과 훈련 과정을 마련하며, AI의 혜택이 동등하게 나누어지도록 정부와 기업, 그리고 개인 간의 협력이 요구될 것이 다.

read.en: ❻ The future is now, and the way we shape the role of AI in our lives will have a profound impact on the future of humanity.
read.ko: 미래는 지금 와 있고, 우리가 우리의 삶에서 AI가 맡을 역할을 어떻게 결정하는지가 인류의 미래에 지대한 영향을 미치게 될 것이다.

para.en: ❶ Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been the subject of much discussion and controversy for many decades, with many experts predicting that it will revolutionize our way of life. ❷ From healthcare to finance, the implementation of AI is transforming a wide range of sectors. ❸ Embracing AI means tapping into the potential of tomorrow in unprecedented ways. ❹ From self-driving cars to personalized medical treatments, AI is shaping our future and pushing the envelope like never before. ❺ As we stand on the brink of a new era, it is crucial that each of us understand the rise of AI and its impacts on our world. ❻ AI is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making, and language translation. ❼ Recent developments have also seen AI taking on more creative roles; AI art generators, for example, are able to take a human’s description in words and transform it directly into art. ❽ AI has been around for several decades, but recent advancements in computing power, data storage, and machine learning algorithms have fueled its rapid growth.

❶ Some of the most significant impacts of AI are increased efficiency and productivity. ❷ Through automation, AI systems and robots can perform repetitive, boring, and dangerous tasks easily, freeing up humans to focus on more innovative and strategic work. ❸ In the healthcare sector, AI is being used to analyze vast amounts of medical data to improve diagnoses. ❹ In finance, AI algorithms are being used to automate administrative tasks, detect fraud, and make investment decisions. ❺ Advocates of AI argue that these advancements will lead to a more efficient, productive, and technical society, where individuals have more time and resources to focus on more meaningful work. ❻ They also argue that AI has the potential to solve complex problems, such as climate change and disease, in ways that were previously impossible. ❼ For example, AI can analyze huge amounts of data quickly to find patterns in weather changes or the spread of a disease. ❽ This could lead to finding solutions to climate change and cures for untreatable illnesses much quicker.

❶ Meanwhile, many critics of AI raise concerns about its impact on employment. ❷ Automation, they argue, will lead to widespread job losses, as machines and robots replace human workers in many industries. ❸ This could lead to increased poverty and income gap, as those who lose their jobs struggle to find new employment in an already competitive job market. ❹ This argument is not without merit. ❺ Automation has already displaced workers in several industries, and it is likely that this trend will continue as AI becomes more widespread. ❻ However, it is also important to consider that automation has been a driving force behind economic growth for centuries and has consistently created new job opportunities, even as it has decreased existing ones. ❼ For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service.

❶ For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service. ❷ The same can be said for the rise of the computer industry in the late 20th century, which displaced workers in manual labor industries, but also created new jobs in software development, information technology, and related fields. ❸ Therefore, it is likely that the rise of AI will also give rise to new job opportunities. ❹ There will be a growing demand for data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI ethics experts, among others. ❺ These jobs will allow individuals to contribute to society in meaningful ways. ❻ At the same time, since they require new skills, education and training will need to evolve to help people prepare for these new opportunities. ❼ By adapting and learning, people can find paths in a world where AI plays a major role.

❶ Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to maintain existing biases and discrimination. ❷ People often view computer systems as objective. ❸ However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely reproduce those biases in its output. ❹ For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones. ❺ This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones. ❻ As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and wrongfully arrested by the police. ❼ This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.

❶ In conclusion, the rise of AI is shaping the future of society in profound ways, and it is important that we consider both the potential benefits and challenges this technology presents. ❷ While AI has the potential to increase efficiency and productivity and solve complex problems, it also has the potential to cause job losses and continue existing biases. ❸ However, as with any revolutionary technology, it is likely that the rise of AI will also create new job opportunities and contribute to economic growth. ❹ It is the responsibility of society to ensure that the development and implementation of AI are done in a responsible and ethical manner. ❺ This will require collaboration between governments, corporations, and individuals to establish regulations and standards, provide education and training programs, and ensure that the benefits of AI are shared equally. ❻ The future is now, and the way we shape the role of AI in our lives will have a profound impact on the future of humanity.
